ayahs.tl: Haa-Meeem
ayahs.en: Ha, Meem.

ayahs.ar: وَالۡكِتٰبِ الۡمُبِيۡنِۛۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wal Kitaabil Mubeen
ayahs.en: By the clear Book,

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡءٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa ja'alnaahu Quraanan 'Arabiyyal la'allakum ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّهٗ فِيۡ٘ اُمِّ الۡكِتٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيۡمٌؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa innahoo feee Ummil Kitaabi Ladainaa la'aliyyun hakeem
ayahs.en: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.

ayahs.ar: اَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنۡكُمُ الذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا اَنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمًا مُّسۡرِفِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Afanadribu 'ankumuz Zikra safhan an kuntum qawmam musrifeen
ayahs.en: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?

ayahs.ar: وَكَمۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ نَّبِيٍّ فِي الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa kam arsalnaa min Nabiyyin fil awwaleen
ayahs.en: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ نَّبِيٍّ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yaateehim min Nabiyyin illaa kaanoo bihee yasahzi'oon
ayahs.en: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.

ayahs.ar: فَاَهۡلَكۡنَا٘ اَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ بَطۡشًا وَّمَضٰي مَثَلُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa ahlaknaaa ashadda minhum batshanw wa madaa masalul lawwaleen
ayahs.en: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡعَلِيۡمُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa la'in sa altahum man khalaqas samaawaati wal arda la yaqoolunna khalaqa hunnal 'Azeezul 'Aleem
ayahs.en: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing."

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ مَهۡدًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda mahdanw wa ja'ala lakum feehaa subulal la'allakum tahtadoon
ayahs.en: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ بِقَدَرٍۚ فَاَنۡشَرۡنَا بِهٖ بَلۡدَةً مَّيۡتًاۚ كَذٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallazee nazzala minas samaaa'i maaa'am biqadarin fa anshamaa bihee baldatam maitaa' kazaalika tukhrajoon
ayahs.en: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَزۡوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡفُلۡكِ وَالۡاَنۡعَامِ مَا تَرۡكَبُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa wa ja'ala lakum minal fulki wal-an'aami maa tarkaboon
ayahs.en: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount.

ayahs.ar: لِتَسۡتَوٗا عَلٰي ظُهُوۡرِهٖ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ اِذَا اسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُوۡلُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِيۡ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقۡرِنِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Litastawoo 'alaa zuhoorihee summa tazkuroo ni'mata Rabbikum izastawaitum 'alaihi wa taqooloo Subhaanal lazee sakhkhara lana haaza wa maa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen
ayahs.en: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّا٘ اِلٰي رَبِّنَا لَمُنۡقَلِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon
ayahs.en: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلُوۡا لَهٗ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ جُزۡءًاؕ اِنَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ لَكَفُوۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌࣖؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'aloo lahoo min 'ibaadihee juz'aa; innal insaana lakafoorum mubeen
ayahs.en: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.

ayahs.ar: اَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنٰتٍ وَّاَصۡفٰىكُمۡ بِالۡبَنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Amit takhaza mimmaa yakhluqu banaatinw wa asfaakum bilbaneen
ayahs.en: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُمۡ بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهٗ مُسۡوَدًّا وَّهُوَ كَظِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa bushshira ahaduhum bimaa daraba lir Rahmaani masalan zalla wajhuhoo muswaddanw wa hua kazeem
ayahs.en: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.

ayahs.ar: اَوَمَنۡ يُّنَشَّؤُا فِي الۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Awa mai yunashsha'u fil hilyati wa huwa fil khisaami ghairu mubeen
ayahs.en: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلُوا الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةَ الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عِبٰدُ الرَّحۡمٰنِ اِنَاثًاؕ اَشَهِدُوۡا خَلۡقَهُمۡ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'alul malaaa'ikatal lazeena hum 'ibaadur Rahmaani inaasaa; a shahidoo khalaqhum; satuktabu shahaa datuhum wa yus'aloon
ayahs.en: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡ شَآءَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنٰهُمۡؕ مَا لَهُمۡ بِذٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍࣗ اِنۡ هُمۡ اِلَّا يَخۡرُصُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo law shaaa'ar Rahmaanu maa 'abadnaahum; maa lahum bizaalika min 'ilmin in hum illaa yakhrusoon
ayahs.en: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ كِتٰبًا مِّنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ فَهُمۡ بِهٖ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Am aatainaahum Kitaabam min qablihee fahum bihee mustamsikoon
ayahs.en: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering?

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا وَجَدۡنَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا عَلٰ٘ي اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰ٘ي اٰثٰرِهِمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Bal qaalooo innaa wajadnaaa aabaaa'anaa 'alaaa ummatinw wa innaa 'alaaa aasaarihim muhtadoon
ayahs.en: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ مَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فِيۡ قَرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوۡهَا٘ۙ اِنَّا وَجَدۡنَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا عَلٰ٘ي اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰ٘ي اٰثٰرِهِمۡ مُّقۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika maaa arsalnaa min qablika fee qaryatim min nazeerin illaa qaala mutrafoohaaa innaa wajadnaaa aabaaa'anaa 'alaaa ummatinw wa innaa 'alaaa aasaarihim muqtadoon
ayahs.en: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."

ayahs.ar: قٰلَ اَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُمۡ بِاَهۡدٰي مِمَّا وَجَدۡتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ اٰبَآءَكُمۡؕ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا بِمَا٘ اُرۡسِلۡتُمۡ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala awa law ji'tukum bi ahdaa mimmaa wajattum 'alaihi aabaaa'akum qaalooo innaa bimaaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon
ayahs.en: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

ayahs.ar: فَانۡتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَانۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fantaqamnaa minhum fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mukazzibeen
ayahs.en: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِنَّنِيۡ بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qaala Ibraaheemu liabeehi wa qawmiheee innane baraaa'um mimmaa ta'budo
ayahs.en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡ فَطَرَنِيۡ فَاِنَّهٗ سَيَهۡدِيۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Illal lazee fataranee innahoo sa yahdeen
ayahs.en: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۭ بَاقِيَةً فِيۡ عَقِبِهٖ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'alahaa Kalimatam baaqiyatan fee 'aqibihee la'al lahum yarji'oon
ayahs.en: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].

ayahs.ar: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ وَاٰبَآءَهُمۡ حَتّٰي جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَقُّ وَرَسُوۡلٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Bal matta'tu haaa'ulaaa'i wa aabaaa'ahum hattaa jaaa'a humul haqqu wa Rasoolum mubeen
ayahs.en: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَقُّ قَالُوۡا هٰذَا سِحۡرٌ وَّاِنَّا بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa jaaa'ahumul haqqu qaaloo haazaa sihrunw wa innaa bihee kaafiroon
ayahs.en: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنُ عَلٰي رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo law laa nuzzila haazal Quraanu 'alaa rajulim minal qaryataini 'azeem
ayahs.en: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"

ayahs.ar: اَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُوۡنَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَؕ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡ مَّعِيۡشَتَهُمۡ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٍ دَرَجٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ بَعۡضًا سُخۡرِيًّاؕ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٌ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata Rabbik; Nahnu qasamnaa bainahum ma'eeshatahum fil hayaatid dunyaa wa rafa'naa ba'dahum fawqa ba'din darajaatil liyattakhiza ba'duhum ba'dan sukhriyyaa; wa rahmatu Rabbika khairum mimmaa yajma'oon
ayahs.en: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ النَّاسُ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَنۡ يَّكۡفُرُ بِالرَّحۡمٰنِ لِبُيُوۡتِهِمۡ سُقُفًا مِّنۡ فِضَّةٍ وَّمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa law laaa any yakoonan naasu ummatanw waahidatal laja'alnaa limany yakfuru bir Rahmaani libu yootihim suqufam min fiddatinw wa ma'aarija 'alaihaa yazharoon
ayahs.en: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount

ayahs.ar: وَلِبُيُوۡتِهِمۡ اَبۡوَابًا وَّسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa libu yootihim abwaabanw wa sururan 'alaihaa yattaki'oon
ayahs.en: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline

ayahs.ar: وَزُخۡرُفًاؕ وَاِنۡ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاؕ وَالۡاٰخِرَةُ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa zukhrufaa; wa in kullu zaalika lammaa mataa'ul hayaatid dunyaa; wal aakhiratu 'inda Rabbika lilmuttaqeen
ayahs.en: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّعۡشُ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهٗ شَيۡطٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهٗ قَرِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa mai ya'shu 'an zikrir Rahmaani nuqaiyid lahoo Shaitaanan fahuwa lahoo qareen
ayahs.en: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّوۡنَهُمۡ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِ وَيَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّهُمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa innahum la yasuddoo nahum 'anis sabeeli wa yahsaboona annahum muhtadoon
ayahs.en: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ الۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ الۡقَرِيۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'anaa qaala yaa laita bainee wa bainaka bu'dal mashriqaini fabi'sal qareen
ayahs.en: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion."

ayahs.ar: وَلَنۡ يَّنۡفَعَكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ اِذۡ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ اَنَّكُمۡ فِي الۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lai yanfa'akumul Yawma iz zalamtum annakum fil 'azaabi mushtarikoon
ayahs.en: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.

ayahs.ar: اَفَاَنۡتَ تُسۡمِعُ الصُّمَّ اَوۡ تَهۡدِي الۡعُمۡيَ وَمَنۡ كَانَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Afa anta tusmi'us summa aw tahdil 'umya wa man kaana fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.en: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?

ayahs.ar: فَاِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَاِنَّا مِنۡهُمۡ مُّنۡتَقِمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa immaa nazhabanna bika fa innaa minhum muntaqimoon
ayahs.en: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.

ayahs.ar: اَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِيۡ وَعَدۡنٰهُمۡ فَاِنَّا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مُّقۡتَدِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Aw nuriyannakal lazee wa'adnaahum fa innaa 'alaihim muqtadiroon
ayahs.en: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.

ayahs.ar: فَاسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِالَّذِيۡ٘ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيۡكَۚ اِنَّكَ عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Fastamsik billazeee oohi ya ilaika innaka 'alaa Siraatim Mustaqeem
ayahs.en: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّهٗ لَذِكۡرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۚ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa innahoo lazikrul laka wa liqawmika wa sawfa tus'aloon
ayahs.en: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.

ayahs.ar: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡ رُّسُلِنَا٘ࣗ اَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ اٰلِهَةً يُّعۡبَدُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Was'al man arsalnaa min qablika mir Rusulinaaa aja'alnaa min doonir Rahmaani aalihatany yu badoon
ayahs.en: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰي بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۠ئِهٖ فَقَالَ اِنِّيۡ رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad arsalnaa Moosaa bi aayaatinaaa ilaa Fir'awna wa mala'ihee faqaala innee Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِذَا هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammma jaaa'ahum bi aayaatinaaa izaa hum minhaa yadhakoon
ayahs.en: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا نُرِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اٰيَةٍ اِلَّا هِيَ اَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ اُخۡتِهَاؗ وَاَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa nureehim min aayatin illaa hiya akbaru min ukhtihaa wa akhaznaahum bil'azaabi la'allahum yarji'oon
ayahs.en: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنۡدَكَۚ اِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo yaaa ayyuhas saahirud'u lanaa Rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka innanaa lamuhtadoon
ayahs.en: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ الۡعَذَابَ اِذَا هُمۡ يَنۡكُثُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa kashafnaa 'anhumul 'azaaba izaa hum yankusoon
ayahs.en: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.

ayahs.ar: وَنَادٰي فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِيۡ قَوۡمِهٖ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَلَيۡسَ لِيۡ مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهٰذِهِ الۡاَنۡهٰرُ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِيۡۚ اَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa naadaa Fir'awnu fee qawmihee qaala yaa qawmi alaisa lee mulku Misra wa haazihil anhaaru tajree min tahtee afalaa tubsiroon
ayahs.en: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ اَنَا خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ هُوَ مَهِيۡنٌ ࣢ۙ وَّلَا يَكَادُ يُبِيۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Am ana khairum min haazal lazee huwa maheenunw wa laa yuakaadu yubeen
ayahs.en: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?

ayahs.ar: فَلَوۡلَا٘ اُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ اَسۡوِرَةٌ مِّنۡ ذَهَبٍ اَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falaw laa ulqiya 'alaihi aswiratum min zahabin awjaaa'a ma'ahul malaaa'ikatu muqtarineen
ayahs.en: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"

ayahs.ar: فَاسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهٗ فَاَطَاعُوۡهُؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fastakhaffa qawmahoo fa ataa'ooh; innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
ayahs.en: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah].

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اٰسَفُوۡنَا انۡتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَاَغۡرَقۡنٰهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Falammaaa aasafoonan taqamnaa minhum fa aghraqnaahum ajma'een
ayahs.en: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.

ayahs.ar: فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ سَلَفًا وَّمَثَلًا لِّلۡاٰخِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Faja'alnaahum salafanw wa masalal lil aakhireen
ayahs.en: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا اِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa duribab nu Maryama masalan izaa qawmu ka minhu yasidoon
ayahs.en: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ هُوَؕ مَا ضَرَبُوۡهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًاؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalooo 'a-aalihatunaa khairun am hoo; maa daraboohu laka illaa jadalaa; balhum qawmun khasimoon
ayahs.en: And they said, "Are your gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا عَبۡدٌ اَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: In huwa illaa 'abdun an'amnaa 'alaihi wa ja'alnaahu masalal li Baneee Israaa'eel
ayahs.en: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡكُمۡ مَّلٰٓئِكَةً فِي الۡاَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law nashaaa'u laja'alnaa minkum malaaa'ikatan fil ardi yakhlufoon
ayahs.en: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّهٗ لَعِلۡمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُوۡنِؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa innahoo la'ilmul lis Saa'ati fala tamtarunna bihaa wattabi'oon; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
ayahs.en: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمۡ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa yasuddan nakumush Shaitaanu innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen
ayahs.en: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيۡسٰي بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُمۡ بِالۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِاُبَيِّنَ لَكُمۡ بَعۡضَ الَّذِيۡ تَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ فِيۡهِۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa jaaa'a 'Eesaa bilbaiyinaati qaala qad ji'tukum bil Hikmati wa li-ubaiyina lakum ba'dal lazee takhtalifoona feehi fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
ayahs.en: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ رَبِّيۡ وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡهُؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Innal laaha Huwa Rabbee wa Rabbukum fa'budooh; haaza Siraatum Mustaqeem
ayahs.en: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."

ayahs.ar: فَاخۡتَلَفَ الۡاَحۡزَابُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِهِمۡۚ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Fakhtalafal ahzaabu mim bainihim fawailul lillazeena zalamoo min 'azaabi Yawmin aleem
ayahs.en: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.

ayahs.ar: هَلۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ بَغۡتَةً وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Hal yanzuroona illas Saa'ata an taatiyahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?

ayahs.ar: اَلۡاَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذٍۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ اِلَّا الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَࣖؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Al akhillaaa'u Yawma'izim ba'duhum liba'din 'aduwwun illal muttaqeen
ayahs.en: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous

ayahs.ar: يٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ وَلَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaa 'ibaadi laa khawfun 'alaikumul Yawma wa laaa antum tahzanoon
ayahs.en: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,

ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَكَانُوۡا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena aamanoo bi Aayaatinaa wa kaanoo muslimeen
ayahs.en: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.

ayahs.ar: اُدۡخُلُوا الۡجَنَّةَ اَنۡتُمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Udkhulul Jannata antum wa azwaajukum tuhbaroon
ayahs.en: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."

ayahs.ar: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِصِحَافٍ مِّنۡ ذَهَبٍ وَّاَكۡوَابٍۚ وَفِيۡهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيۡهِ الۡاَنۡفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الۡاَعۡيُنُۚ وَاَنۡتُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Yutaafu 'alaihim bishaa fim min zahabinw wa akwaab, wa feehaa maatashtaheehil anfusu wa talazzul a'yunu wa antum feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.en: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.

ayahs.ar: وَتِلۡكَ الۡجَنَّةُ الَّتِيۡ٘ اُوۡرِثۡتُمُوۡهَا بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa tilkal jannatul lateee ooristumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.

ayahs.ar: لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيۡرَةٌ مِّنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Lakum feehaa faakihatun kaseeratum minhaa taakuloon
ayahs.en: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ فِيۡ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal mujrimeena fee 'azaabi jahannama khaalidoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.

ayahs.ar: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيۡهِ مُبۡلِسُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Laa yufattaru 'anhum wa hum feehi mublisoon
ayahs.en: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنٰهُمۡ وَلٰكِنۡ كَانُوۡا هُمُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa zalamnaahum wa laakin kaanoo humuz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَنَادَوۡا يٰمٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَؕ قَالَ اِنَّكُمۡ مّٰكِثُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa naadaw yaa Maaliku liyaqdi 'alainaa Rabbuka qaala innakum maakisson
ayahs.en: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنٰكُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كٰرِهُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laqad ji'naakum bilhaqqi wa laakinna aksarakum lilhaqqi kaarihoon
ayahs.en: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ اَبۡرَمُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّا مُبۡرِمُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Am abramooo amran fainnaa mubrimoon
ayahs.en: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ يَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوٰىهُمۡؕ بَلٰي وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Am yahsaboona annaa laa nasma'u sirrahum wa najwaahum; balaa wa Rusulunaa ladaihim yaktuboon
ayahs.en: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنۡ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ وَلَدٌࣗۖ فَاَنَا اَوَّلُ الۡعٰبِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul in kaana lir Rahmaani walad; fa-ana awwalul 'aabideen
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."

ayahs.ar: سُبۡحٰنَ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ رَبِّ الۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Subhaana Rabbis samaawaati wal ardi Rabbil Arshi 'ammaa yasifoon
ayahs.en: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

ayahs.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوۡضُوۡا وَيَلۡعَبُوۡا حَتّٰي يُلٰقُوۡا يَوۡمَهُمُ الَّذِيۡ يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fazarhum yakhoodoo wa yal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo Yawmahumul lazee yoo'adoon
ayahs.en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ فِي السَّمَآءِ اِلٰهٌ وَّفِي الۡاَرۡضِ اِلٰهٌؕ وَهُوَ الۡحَكِيۡمُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal lazee fissamaaa'i Ilaahunw wa fil ardi Ilaah; wa Huwal Hakeemul'Aleem
ayahs.en: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: وَتَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۚ وَعِنۡدَهٗ عِلۡمُ السَّاعَةِۚ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa tabaarakal lazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa 'indahoo 'ilmus Saa'ati wa ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.en: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ الَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَهِدَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa yamlikul lazeena yad'oona min doonihish shafaa'ata illaa man shahida bilhaqqi wa hum ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُ فَاَنّٰي يُؤۡفَكُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa la'in sa altahum man khalaqahum la yaqoolun nallaahu fa annaa yu'fakoon
ayahs.en: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded?

ayahs.ar: وَقِيۡلِهٖ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٌ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۘ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qeelihee yaa Rabbi inna haa'ulaaa'i qawmul laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."

ayahs.ar: فَاصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلٰمٌؕ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fasfah 'anhum wa qul salaam; fasawfa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
